The most recent Republican to win a New York gubernatorial election was **George Pataki**, who was first elected in 1994.  In that 1994 campaign his name appeared on the ballot under three party lines:

| Party line on the ballot |
|---------------------------|
| Republican |
| Conservative |
| Tax Cut Now |

These lines are listed in the official New York State Board of Elections results for the 1994 Governor contest, where Pataki is shown as *“George Pataki – Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now”*【1†L18-L22】【1†L44-L54】.
